run:
set -e
# 문장은 argv 한 칸으로 들어온다 ($1). 셸을 안 거치므로 따옴표가 있어도 안 갈린다.
bin/tts-typecast.sh "$1" "$OUT/greeting.mp3"

$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$f = Join-Path $env:IN 'greeting.mp3';Write-Output ('file=' + $f + ' exists=' + (Test-Path $f));if (-not (Test-Path $f)) { exit 6 };$mp = Get-Command mpg123 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;if ($mp) { Write-Output 'player=mpg123'; & $mp.Source -q $f; exit $LASTEXITCODE };$ff = Get-Command ffplay -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;if ($ff) { Write-Output 'player=ffplay'; & $ff.Source -nodisp -autoexit -loglevel error $f; exit $LASTEXITCODE };Write-Output 'player=MediaPlayer';Add-Type -AssemblyName PresentationCore;$p = New-Object System.Windows.Media.MediaPlayer;$p.Open([Uri]$f);$n = 0; while (-not $p.NaturalDuration.HasTimeSpan -and $n -lt 40) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; $n++ };$d = 5.0; if ($p.NaturalDuration.HasTimeSpan) { $d = $p.NaturalDuration.TimeSpan.TotalSeconds };$p.Volume = 1.0; $p.Play();Start-Sleep -Seconds ([Math]::Ceiling($d) + 1);$p.Stop(); $p.Close();Write-Output ('played seconds=' + $d)
